Left out capitals that are disputed, moving or split (Jerusalem, Jakarta, La Paz/Sucre, Pretoria, Bern); Amsterdam is kept as it is the constitutional capital of the Netherlands, cities in countries that span two continents (Moscow, Ankara) and capitals where 'biggest city' depends on how you count (Brussels, Accra, Quito).
